facts.statement: The escrow was opened with a total of 300000000 split into three milestones.

The claimant posted a 5000000 deposit when opening the dispute, matching the escrow bond.
At slot 534320003 the escrow shows milestone 0 Released, milestone 1 Disputed under this dispute, and milestone 2 Pending.
The disputed milestone 1 funds have not been released or refunded to either party.
Milestone #1 work was delivered off chain by the seller.
Any off-chain acceptance or rejection notice was exchanged between buyer and seller.

claims.statement: Milestone #1 was delivered, so its locked funds should be released to the seller.
Milestone #1 was not delivered, so its locked funds should be refunded to the buyer.

gaps: No evidence shows whether the milestone #1 deliverable was actually produced or handed over off chain.
No acceptance criteria or contract terms for milestone #1 appear in the evidence.
No off-chain communications between buyer and seller are included.
The reason the buyer released milestone 0 but not milestone 1 is not shown.
The escrow lists a settlement_mint different from the deposit mint, and no evidence explains the conversion.
